dashboardQueries.name: c5f1308c-6d17-4393-8716-4c176fd3ad2b
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "conn" OR metadata.product_event_type = "conn_red" OR metadata.product_event_type = "conn_long" OR metadata.product_event_type = "conn_agg"
observer.hostname!=""
principal.ip!=""
target.ip!=""
$country_len=strings.length(principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
$host_len=strings.length(principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain)
($host_len=0 AND $country_len=0) OR $host_len > 0
$service=if(about.namespace!="", about.namespace, "Unknown")
(((principal.ip="") OR (principal.ip!="0.0.0.0" AND principal.ip!="255.255.255.255")) AND ((target.ip="") OR (target.ip!="0.0.0.0" AND target.ip!="255.255.255.255"))) OR about.labels["local_resp"] != "true"
about.labels["local_orig"]="false" AND about.labels["local_resp"]="true"
$hostname=if(principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain!="", principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain, "Unknown")
match:
    principal.ip, target.ip, $hostname,principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
outcome:
    $distinct_service=array_distinct($service)
    $orig_byte_sum=sum(cast.as_float(principal.labels["orig_ip_bytes"]))
order:
    $orig_byte_sum desc 
limit:
    10

dashboardQueries.name: e347962a-b0ae-4835-8c03-ff6a99189a0c
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "conn" OR metadata.product_event_type = "conn_red" OR metadata.product_event_type = "conn_long" OR metadata.product_event_type = "conn_agg"
observer.hostname!=""
principal.ip!=""
target.ip!=""
(((principal.ip="") OR (principal.ip!="0.0.0.0" AND principal.ip!="255.255.255.255")) AND ((target.ip="") OR (target.ip!="0.0.0.0" AND target.ip!="255.255.255.255"))) OR about.labels["local_resp"] != "true"
$service = if(about.namespace!="", about.namespace, "Unknown")
$service!=""
$uid=metadata.ingestion_labels.value

match:
    $uid
outcome:
    $duration=math.round(window.avg(network.session_duration.seconds), 3)
    $principal_ip=array_distinct(principal.ip)
    $target_ip=array_distinct(target.ip)
    $target_port=array_distinct(target.port)
    $distinct_service=array_distinct($service)
order:
    $duration desc 
limit:
    100

dashboardQueries.name: f26c3d29-435b-48be-a183-008312cb9651
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"

    $bytes_out = sum(cast.as_float(principal.labels["orig_ip_bytes"]))
